title: Voice test: the same 30 seconds in each voice
about: A passage from Act 2 of the Norway script, including a scripted [beat]. Run pipeline/voice/voice_test.sh to remake the clips in out/voice-tests/.

lines.say: Then came the two rules that matter most.
The first is that the money has to be invested outside Norway, in companies and property all over the world, so that it can't flood the economy at home.
The second arrived in two thousand and one, and it's the heart of the whole story.
So how much of its oil fortune is Norway allowed to spend each year? [beat 1.3] Around three percent.
That's roughly what the fund is expected to earn, after inflation.
